title: Ex-Keralam Excise Commissioner Seeram Sambasiva Rao flags corruption, bribery in report to govt
description: Report names Joint Excise Commissioner S. Vinod and Deputy Commissioner Ajay and recommends their immediate removal from field postings and a Vigilance probe against them. It also mentions that Excise Minister M. Liju has a close acquaintance with a bar in Kayamkulam, although there are no details about what kind of relationship the Minister was maintaining with bar authorities
